0022600221.text: The Nuggets (5-3, winners of two straight, 3-1 on the road) visit the Grizzlies (6-3, but on a three-game losing streak) in Denver's 10th game of the season, with Denver 9th in the West and Memphis 7th. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Denver won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-119 win in Denver in their last meeting.
